description: Saves AI Agent configuration. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true; activation requires acceptedAiAgentTerms=true and disabling requires disableWarningConfirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

acceptedAiAgentTerms.description: Required as true when enabling AI Agent.

body.description: WAPI SaveAgentChannelConfigurationRequest body, for example Enabled=true/false.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

disableWarningConfirmed.description: Required as true when disabling AI Agent after warning that it will stop learning and may need to start over if reactivated.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_save_ai_agent_configuration
title: Save Ai Agent Configuration
